summary: Triggers an action. Verb first, naming the outcome.

pairs.why: A ghost with a resting fill reads as Outline, so the hierarchy between a primary and a tertiary action collapses and every toolbar looks equally important.
pairs.source: Found on 168 buttons in the Figma library — audit §17.2

pairs.dont: Put Link in a box — fill, border or radius.
pairs.do: Leave Link as text, coloured by fg/link/*.
pairs.why: A link drawn as a button is ambiguous about whether it navigates or acts. fg/link carries it at 7.66:1 without a box.
textDecoration propagates across every node sharing a text style, so underlining Link in Figma underlines all 168 buttons. Colour distinguishes it; the underline is a hover affordance.

pairs.dont: Ship an icon-only button with no accessible name.
pairs.do: Pass aria-label on every icon-* size.
pairs.why: Screen readers announce nothing. The icon sizes have no text child by definition, so the label has to come from the attribute.

pairs.dont: Reach for a larger Size to get bigger text.
pairs.do: Pick Size for height and touch target.
pairs.why: Size changes height and padding; the label stays label/md. Resizing an instance to force a height is how 36 instances ended up off-scale.

pairs.dont: Set a Button to vertical HUG in Figma.
pairs.do: Leave it at its variant height.
pairs.why: Its vertical padding is inert, so a HUG instance collapses to 16–18px. This broke 22 instances once already.

pairs.dont: Put two primary buttons side by side.
pairs.do: One primary; everything else a step quieter.
pairs.why: Primary means “this is the next thing to do”. Two of them means neither is, and the reader has to work out the hierarchy the design was supposed to give them.

pairs.do: Name the outcome — "Save changes", "Delete probe", "Export CSV".
pairs.why: The label is the only thing many people read before clicking. Two or three words; if it needs more, the explanation belongs above the button.
pairs.source: Tone of voice — Buttons and labels

pairs.dont: Use Destructive without a confirmation that restates what is lost.
pairs.do: Name the thing in both the button and the confirm.
pairs.why: Destructive is a warning, not a safeguard. "Delete probe" then "Delete probe SYD-03? Its history is removed."

a11y: Focus ring is border/focused at 2px with a 2px offset; never remove it.
loading sets aria-busy and disables the button — a busy button must not be activatable.
Disabled contrast is 2.24:1 by design. SC 1.4.3 exempts disabled controls; the low contrast is the signal.
